specification_points.description: Determine orders of reaction from experimental data (initial rates and concentration-time graphs)
Write and use rate equations: rate = k[A]^m[B]^n
Use the Arrhenius equation k = Ae^(-Ea/RT); construct and interpret ln k vs 1/T graphs
Propose and test reaction mechanisms consistent with the rate equation
Define Brønsted-Lowry acid and base; identify conjugate pairs
Calculate pH from [H⁺]; use Kw = [H⁺][OH⁻] = 1.0×10⁻¹⁴ at 25°C
Calculate Ka and pKa; distinguish strong and weak acids
Describe buffer solutions and calculate pH of buffers using Ka
Define oxidation and reduction in terms of electron transfer and oxidation numbers
Construct half-equations and overall redox equations
Use standard electrode potentials to predict cell EMF and feasibility of reactions
Describe fuel cells and rechargeable batteries
